en: Working for work's sake is a laborer's virtue and nothing more. It holds no value for me.
(I'm not one to talk, but man, this guy's rotten to the core.)
Okay, so you're not the kind of guy who goes out and aggressively pursues love or a career.
That is simply how we aristocrats "roll," to put it in your common vernacular. You peons comply with our every whim. Why would we ever lift a finger?
Let's find you a job, Leo-kun!
You speak madness, plebeian!
Look, man. When you meet girls, you have to introduce yourself.
That includes your employment status. Admitting you're unemployed won't go over well. You should at least have a part-time job.
A part-time job? At my age? What woman would find that attractive?
You have a point there. I guess we'll have to find you a regular nine-to-five job!
Um... Shinada... 'Tis strange enough getting personal advice from you, but I do not believe I need your advice on employment. Have <Italic>you</Italic> ever held a nine-to-five job?
Right. Point well taken.
You forget yourself, commoner. I shan't suffer a lecture from my underling. Now, if you cannot make yourself useful, then your life means nothing.
That's all there is to my life? Making myself useful? Well, I guess that's not wrong, but still.
Anyway, no one knows how hard it is to have a real job in this town better than me!
Let's pretend we never had this conversation!
Oh. Um, yes. Well, put forth more effort to appease me next time.
Okay, Leo-kun, let's find you a hobby so you'll have something to talk about when you meet a girl.
After all, girls don't like guys with too much time on their hands and no hobbies or interests.
I never said I didn't have a hobby. I often go yachting, after all.
Really? Yachting?
That's right. I hope you are not suggesting I simply let my yacht rot in the harbor.
You have a yacht? As in one of those super big, super expensive boats?
I wouldn't consider it "super expensive," as you say. I was able to buy mine with just my allowance.
Oh, well never mind me, then. I thought you didn't have any hobbies.
You truly know nothing. I also play golf and travel overseas.
Right... I guess it's back to the drawing board.
You have to get used to talking to girls, and that takes lots of practice!
Practice, you say? But you don't strike me as a ladies' man, Shinada. I am unsure if I've even seen you talking to a woman.
You're one to talk, Leo-kun! And anyway, I've had my fair share of conversations with women!
Anyway, let's have you practice getting to know girls through conversation. The best way to learn is by doing, after all.
Wait, do you intend to toss me into some vulgar establishment again!? I've had enough of such dens of debauchery!
No, I wouldn't dream of it! Now, follow me.
Very well. Though I am loath to admit it, your advice has proven to be effective.
It has? Sweet! Told you I knew what I was talking about!
Do not forget yourself. You are a witless peasant now and forever.
Oh. Well, fine.
Be grateful, however, for among my fellow aristocrats, I alone am exceptionally skilled at listening to opinions of your kind.
Hm. I feel like I should be annoyed at that, but I guess I'm getting used to you.
So? What's next?
I think I need a little background info first.
It's been a while since you got rid of your makeup. How've things been?
Well, my skin seems to shine with a luster heretofore absent from my complexion.
Uh... No. I meant, how have the people around you reacted?
How have they reacted? The same as ever. Wherefore do you ask?
(I see losing the makeup wasn't enough. This is going to be harder than I thought.)
Don't you want to try some new clothes?
I already told you no. Do not make me repeat myself.
What happened when you went to that hostess club? Did your hostess say anything?
Quoth she, I have a look that is all my own. I took it as a compliment.
Uh, no, she was just trying to be nice. You probably freaked her right the heck out.
But⑬! Well, I suppose it's not impossible.
You don't look too surprised.
When first we met, it was as though her countenance was carved from stone.
See!? You totally freaked her out.
Hmm... Perhaps it is beyond the abilities of the peasantry to fathom my sublime fashion sense.
(Yes! I think I just planted a seed of doubt about his clothes!)
Let me ask you this, Leo-kun. Is there anything you want to try?
Isn't it a little late to be asking me that now?
As a noble, I can do anything I want. After all, I have money, time, and power. Your peasant's perspective is far below mine, so I don't expect you to comprehend that.
I must admit, however, that some things are better seen with one's face in the dirt, hence why I allow you to continue to be my vassal.
Uh... Wow. Sorry.
(Guess I'll have to choose.)
We've already tried a bunch of things, so I think it's time to go big or go home.
"Go big or go home"? I cannot fathom what's brewing within the mush of your brain, but I like not the sound of it.
Let's go where the girls are! After all, practice makes perfect!
Absolutely not. No more hostess clubs. Besides, you said I "freaked the girl right the heck out," did you not?
Oh, right.
Use your peasant brain! Returning now would be akin to opening my own belly!
Do you have to be so morbid?
What a dim candle you are, truly! The dimmest of all the peasants I know.
But peasant or no, you are still human. Therefore I must insist you stop bringing shame upon our species.
Now that's just uncalled-for! But fine, I'll think of something else.
Don't you want to try some new clothes, Leo-kun?
You are persistent, aren't you?
Your clothing is what's holding you back. We won't get anywhere till you make some major fashion changes.
I mean, who in the world would want to go on a date with someone dressed like you!?
Why you insolent peon! How dare you speak to me like that!?
Seriously, Leo-kun! I'm telling you flat out, that outfit has to go!
Either it goes or I go!
Stop whining! Everything I've helped you achieve will be meaningless unless you ditch that damn cosplay!
Now follow me!
Cosplay!? Wait, Shinada!
You know how your body starts going downhill after thirty?
Well, why not start going to the gym? You'll get ripped, and you might even meet a girl there.
The gym? What madness do you speak!?
You already know how strong I am. The question is, do you know why?
Uh... I never thought to ask.
Because I train at my personal gym at home. And I have my own pro-level personal trainer.
So lecture me not about staying in shape. I am much more concerned about the well-being of my body than you peasants are.
Whoa, you have your own gym? Guess I was way off on that one. My bad.
Advice time! Let's talk about your life! Man, I'm really starting to enjoy this!
Calm yourself, peasant. Your enthusiasm is worthless without ideas to accompany it.
Listen, Leo-kun, I'm gonna give it to you straight.
There's only one thing to do this late in the game: practice, practice, practice.
Wait... Really?
You're as prepared as you'll ever be, buddy. It's time to hop out of the nest and spread your wings.
Spread my wings? What crazy idea have you come up with this time?
Oh, nothing so crazy. Just picking up a girl.
Just picking up a⑬!? Listen here, you⑬
Stop right there. I know exactly what you're going to say, Leo-kun.
"I want to meet a girl the right way, not by picking one up. That's so very boorish," or something like that.
Um... Yes. Such vulgar behavior is for peasants. I would fain not begin any relationship under such pretense.
Leo-kun... That's the only way you're gonna get a relationship.
What nonsense!
You're already thirty-five, right? That's thirty-five years without a girlfriend, Leo-kun!
And your point is?
You don't have time for a fairytale romance, man!
You've already waited your whole life. Are you just gonna keep waiting until a girl falls into your lap?
That's ridiculous. I haven't been waiting since the moment I was born.
You know what I mean! Besides, you'll never meet anyone if you keep sitting on your ass!
You have to fight! You have to take what you want! You feel me?
I don't know. That sounds almost criminal to me. Are you trying to get me arrested?
Listen, Leo-kun, this is like gambling. You can't win if you don't play.
And now that we've got that settled, let's get out there and pick up some chicks!
I don't know what chickens have to do with it, but very well.
So now what do I do?
Uh... What do you mean?
Well, I've agreed to try, so now you must instruct me. Or have you forgotten that this is not something that one of my station usually participates in?
(He blew it last time, so I better guide him better this time.)
The best way to flirt with a girl is...
I should have seen that coming. Hmm, what's the best way to flirt with a girl?
Let her know what you're like by introducing yourself.
Start with an introduction, you say? Such as telling her my name and age?
Sure, and throw in your hobbies and skills, too.
And that is all I must do?
Excuse me, ma'am. Do you have a moment?
Who, me?
Allow me to introduce myself. I am Leo Ayanokoji, age thirty-five. My hobbies include yachting and golf, and I am an expert armsman.
Oh... Okay...
Um, can I go now?
By... By all means.
That was no error on my part. I'm sure I did everything you said.
Nah, you're right. That was my bad.
How utterly humiliating...
I said I was sorry. Let me think of something else.
Girls love it when you're funny. Charm the hell out of them by telling a good joke or something.
I haven't exactly got my finger upon the pulse of peasant culture, but do you people always have a good jape handy?
I wouldn't say everybody, but some of us do. But I'm sure your sophisticated aristocrat brain could come up with a real zinger.
At galas, we hire professional humorists to furnish our entertainment. 'Tis not something we are like to do ourselves.
Okay, why don't you tell a joke one of those pros delivered, then?
Hmm... I'm certain this will end badly, but I shall trust you.
Yes, um. Why did Taro throw the clock out of the window?
Because he wanted to see time fly!
Ouch... Next idea.
That's odd. I believe that's one of the better jokes I've heard.
Better!? That was awful! And really old, too!
Awful is your attempt to turn me into a comedian!
Girls love a good compliment. I mean, who doesn't?
Perhaps, but just how does one initiate such an encounter? And what should I compliment?
Try her appearance or voice. Anything's fine as long as it makes her feel good about herself.
Flattery is not my strong suit, but I shall endeavor to woo her nonetheless.
Excuse me, fair maiden. Do you have a moment?
Fair maiden, how might I describe thee? Thou art as silk upon a spring afternoon, soft and radiant and refreshing!
I witnessed thee shining from over yonder, and it was then that I knew mine entire life was but a dying flame next to thy blazing sun!
I have laid eyes upon countless noble dames and damsels, but even their painted countenances cannot compare to the perfection of thy natural complexion!
...I don't understand.
Oh, um... Well, you see, my papa is the chairman of the neighborhood association, so we often attend parties of that noble nature.
Chairman? Oh, so by noble, you mean you're rich?
Not everyone who attends is rich, but my family could certainly be considered wealthy.
Behold! We have exchanged mobile phone numbers!
Um, Leo-kun? You only landed her after you mentioned how rich you are.
Really? Well, she did seem to warm up to me in the middle of the conversation for some reason.
Welcome to the real world, Leo-kun.
Still, I'd say this is progress. I mean, with the way you used to look, even your money wouldn't have gotten you so far.
So all I have to do is send a text to her mobile number?
Whoa, slow down there, cowboy. Take some time to think about what you're going to say.
Ah, of course. But still, I am satisfied. I admit that you have served me well.
Yeah, uh... I think you impressed her with your money, but that's about it.
What did you just say?
Er, never mind! See you again soon!
All right, advice time! Let's talk about your life!
Nay, we must discuss what I must do with that maiden's mobile phone number.
That's an easy one. Just text her!
You simpleton! That part is apparent. I do not, however, know what to write.
